title: 单词的压缩编码
summary: 用一个以井号分隔的字符串编码所有单词，使每个单词都是某个井号前缀段的后缀，求最短编码长度。
insight: 如果一个单词是另一单词的后缀，就无需单独编码；从集合中删除每个单词的所有真后缀，剩余词各贡献长度加一。
pitfalls: 只删除从下标一开始的真后缀，不能删除单词自身
每个保留词还要计一个井号

solutions.title: 集合删除真后缀
solutions.idea: 保留不属于任何更长单词后缀的词。
steps: 把所有 words 放入集合去重
对每个原单词，依次删除 substring(1),substring(2)...
累加集合中每个词 length+1

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumLengthEncoding(String[] words){Set<String> remaining=new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(words));for(String word:words)for(int start=1;start<word.length();start++)remaining.remove(word.substring(start));int answer=0;for(String word:remaining)answer+=word.length()+1;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumLengthEncoding(words:Array<String>):Int{val remaining=words.toMutableSet();for(word in words)for(start in 1 until word.length)remaining.remove(word.substring(start));return remaining.sumOf{it.length+1}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimumLengthEncoding(vector<string>& words){unordered_set<string> remaining(words.begin(),words.end());for(string& word:words)for(int start=1;start<(int)word.size();++start)remaining.erase(word.substr(start));int answer=0;for(string word:remaining)answer+=word.size()+1;return answer;} };
